mentions.name: Aminosplore
mentions.description: Web tool for comparing the essential amino acid content of different foods using a spider web chart. Recently revived after going dormant due to USDA API changes, it now also includes macros and lets users combine foods into actual recipes.
mentions.source_excerpt: Also revived old project - https://aminosplore.metacursion.com - the idea was to compare what essential amino acids each food contains using spider web chart. It’s been dead for a while due to USDA API changes so I revived, added macros and enabled to build foods into actual recipes.
